messages:
tara: rolling out quant-kernel v3opt to canary (2%) in us-west now — bake window 45m, smoke + perf checks. pinging ops for visibility
ken: copy. which perf baselines are we validating? tail p50/p95 + kv miss rate?
maria: yes p50/p95 + mem growth over 30m. also watch kv-cache warmstart latency, we saw weird tails in staging earlier.
jin: deploybot preflight passed for bundle hash abc123, packaging checksum ok. smoke script invoked: `./smoke.sh --quick`
deploybot: preflight OK — bundle abc123 signed, canary slice=2%, target regions=[us-west], TTL-pin=1h
ryan: noticed the staging run had a ~6% p95 regression for short prompts at seq<=64. team said quant-v3opt had different matmul kernel ordering. we should gate on p95 <= 3% reg.
tara: agreed. if p95 >= 3% at end of bake, we'll pin and rollback. adding to release notes: "rollback criteria: p95 regression >= 3% or error rate spike >0.2%"
olivia: can we stagger to eu-west after us-west clears? prefer twilight window for eu to avoid peak traffic.
maria: yes, plan: us-west 2% -> 10% after 30m if ok -> eu-west 2% (twilight) -> ramp to 20% next day AM. keep asia off for now.
jin: setting alerting: temp alert group `quant-canary-watch` with traces+profiles. If kv-cache miss rate > 1% we alert.
ken: fyi ops, if we need immediate rollback, run `deploybot rollback -t canary -v previous` — also leave TTL-pin so previous remains available for 2h.
deploybot: canary slice adjusted per plan. next automatic step: +8% at 00:30 UTC if no alerts. TTL-pin set to 3600s for new bundle.
ryan: can we extend TTL-pin to 7200s? gives quick revert window without rebuilding route tables.
tara: ok set to 7200s. jin, please ensure the rollback playbook is top line in the release note PR.
jin: done — PR description updated and linked: https://git.internal/runtime/releases/merge/8472 (added rollback steps, smoke commands, and observability dashboard link)
maria: quick ask — if we see thermal-induced throttling on subset of hosts, fallback policy should prefer matmul-v2 kernel variant automatically. is that configured?
ken: yes fallback mapping exists: quant-v3opt -> matmul-v2 fallback. deploybot will reroute traffic to fallback variant for affected hosts. still notify on-call.
olivia: I'm going to edit the release notes to call out the twilight roll window and the canary gating thresholds. tagging @oncall for midnight coverage. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
ryan: small postdeploy checklist: 1) confirm p95 <= baseline+3% 2) no uptick in decoding errors 3) KV warmstart hit ratio stable 4) no host thermal alarms
tara: if any one of these fails, we pin and rollback. if minor perf flaps but no errors, hold at 10% and investigate for 1h.
deploybot: canary passed first 15m smoke (no errors). next check in 30m for p95 trend.
jen: noted — I'll be watching metrics and will call for rollback if thresholds breach.
ken: thanks team. will update the incident channel if anything changes.
ci-bot: deploy pipeline logs available: https://ci.internal/builds/8472/logs
maria: reminder — update the public release notes only after eu-west ramp completes and we confirm no rollbacks.
tara: sounds good. keeping this thread pinned for the ops handover during twilight."
